# OLMS Applications

> Federal portal for labor union financial disclosures, electronic form submissions, and public records managed by the Office of Labor-Management Standards.

OLMS Applications provides union organizations, officers, and the public with tools to file required labor-management reports (LM forms), access financial disclosures, and search union records. The platform is operated by the U.S. Department of Labor's Office of Labor-Management Standards under the Labor-Management Reporting and Disclosure Act (LMRDA).

## Key Topics

- Office of Labor-Management Standards (OLMS)
- Online Public Disclosure Room (OPDR)
- Electronic Forms System (EFS)
- Labor-Management Reporting and Disclosure Act (LMRDA)
- LM-1 and LM-2 forms
- Labor union financial reports
- Union organization search
- Public disclosure database
- User authentication and account management
- Labor organization filings
- Union records
- Financial disclosure
- Department of Labor (DOL)

## Public Disclosure & Search

- [Online Public Disclosure Room (OPDR)](https://olmsapps.dol.gov/olpdr/): Access labor union financial reports, disclosures, and filings through the public database
- [Search Unions](https://olmsapps.dol.gov/query/getOrgQry.do): Search for union organizations and access their public records in the OLMS database

## Electronic Forms & User Accounts

- [Electronic Forms System - Login](https://olmsapps.dol.gov/efsui/authentication.action): Authenticate and manage user accounts for submitting labor-management forms (LM-1, LM-2, and related filings)
